Cookie Launcher Android 1.0.0
- FoldCraftLauncher (GPL-3.0) tabanli ilk surum
- Arayuz Turkce, Cookie Launcher marka ve renk temasi

Cookie Launcher Android 1.0.0
- First release, based on FoldCraftLauncher (GPL-3.0)
- Turkish UI, Cookie Launcher branding and color theme
- Download mods/modpacks from Modrinth and CurseForge
- Runs Minecraft: Java Edition on Android
